signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Develop an understanding of customer workflows, business needs, challenges, and product requirements through direct interaction with clients and internal stakeholders.
Contribute to product roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, and product planning activities.
Participate in customer discovery sessions, requirements discussions, product demonstrations, and feedback meetings.
Analyze customer requests to identify underlying needs and broader product opportunities.
Partner with engineering, design, quality assurance, implementation, customer success, support, sales, and other teams to support product delivery.
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for the Award Management suite, aligned to company strategy and growth goals.
Build, lead, and develop a team of product managers, setting goals, coaching performance, and growing talent within the function.
Define and execute a multi-platform strategy across the Award Management portfolio, sequencing investment across products that serve different stages of the sponsored project…
Partner with engineering leadership to plan platform migrations, consolidations, and modernization work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
Represent the Award Management strategy and roadmap to the executive team and other stakeholders, and contribute to company-level product and portfolio planning.
